candidates.snippet: 1862: First Telegraph Office - Edison began working as a telegrapher, a skill that would influence his early inventions. 1877: Invention of the Phonograph - Edison invented the phonograph, the first device to record and reproduce sound. 1879: Development of Electric Light System - Edison perfected a practical incandescent light bulb and developed a system for electric power distribution. 1892: Founding of General Electric - Edison's companies merged to form the Edison General Electric Company, a precursor to General Electric.
